answer: Exclusive settlement accounts can cap sybil weight. Each agent locks collateral and binds one bank or card instrument under a unique marble serial that cannot move mid-epoch. Independent auditors form a prism: they re-hash the routing fingerprint and accept it only if it stays uniquely bound. Unscheduled micro-credits must be acknowledged with a signed memo before the window closes. If two acknowledgements wander back to the same instrument, or a memo is late, every linked deposit is burned. Fielding N votes requires N funded accounts and N deposits at risk; spare keypairs add no weight.
